第 2 页：Background The electrodes of a lithium-ion battery are porous, consisting of an active solid material, a binder, and pores filled with liquid electrolyte If a force is applied on the porous layers of a battery, this will affect the volume fraction of the electrolyte-filled pores in the electrodes, which in turn  induces convection of the electrolyte The intercoupling between solid mechanics and fluid mechanics in porous media is also called  poroelasticity This example demonstrates how to model  poroelasticity  effects
